title: Special committee on property tax reform
summary: The special committee on real property tax reform recessed on September 16 until the next day because of a problem with the agenda's Teams link, which staff said OIP advised could be a Sunshine Law violation if someone complained; the vice chair disagreed. Testifiers that day asked for bigger tax breaks for severely disabled people, said Bill 113 needs more study, and noted a property's tax class can lag its use by up to 18 months. The council created the committee on July 25 by a seven-aye vote.
